gen-gf-autour-one-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Loud and rounded, with a smooth channel into each bowl of Autour One. Padyakke Expanded One spreads its serif letters wide apart, so extended text moves at a slow, authoritative, literary pace.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Round, loud and unmistakable: Autour One opens a clear channel into every bowl, with barely any step down to lowercase. Beside it, Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif, lets each character float.
gen-gf-averia-serif-libre-fs-rowan: Commanding yet mild, Averia Serif Libre keeps its thick strokes fairly gentle for a display face. Rowan opens its curves generously and is happiest with little text, while the heading font handles the drama.
gen-gf-badeen-display-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with caps barely taller than lowercase. Over longer text it stays friendly but suits snippets better, and Badeen Display fills the line with widely spaced lowercase.
gen-gf-bahiana-fs-rowan: Tight, rod-stock blocks: Bahiana packs its words in with narrow gaps. Rowan, with its generous curves and moderate stroke contrast, handles modest bits of reading, while Bahiana earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-bakbak-one-fs-paquito: Rolled-tin curls and oversized lowercase make Bakbak One loud, every stroke held to a single constant width. Paquito, the serif here, takes the quieter work of briefer, friendlier text.
gen-gf-baloo-2-fs-karma: Open, expressive and full of breathing room, Baloo 2 announces itself. Karma handles the quieter, text-bound work, with gentle thick-thin variation and terminals ending well away from the stem.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-fs-karma: Karma is a trustworthy serif whose terminals stop short of the stem, with only a tight step from lowercase to caps. And its gentle modulation keeps extended reading smooth, while Baloo Bhaina 2 brings the bold, high-set x-height.
gen-gf-baloo-paaji-2-fs-paquito: Approachable and confident, Paquito keeps caps and lowercase close in height, though lengthy blocks of text would wear on it. The draw is Baloo Paaji 2, with towering lowercase held open.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-karma: Tall, open and unmistakable, Baloo Tamma 2 leads with big counters. Karma takes over with strokes that thicken and thin in gentle steps, so extended reading glides along without snagging.
